svg.text: main: leafdn_i0 (in) -> vp.ln -> vn_a/vn_b -> vq -> leafup_o0 (out)
Links by group (bits, role) red = broadcast/gather, blue = registered station
vn_a -> vp.ln : 6810 b, broadcast/gather (1 port -> >=3 cores)
vn_b -> vp.ln : 5763 b, broadcast/gather (1 port -> >=3 cores)
vs <-> vsw : 483 b, point-to-point, registered station
vn_a -> vp.b0 : 261 b, broadcast/gather (1 port -> >=3 cores)
vn_a -> vp.b1 : 261 b, broadcast/gather (1 port -> >=3 cores)
Timing-critical pairs: base pin-to-pin length vs the nominal reach ((regs+1) x 405 um; negative = relies on in-core / pin-flop budget)
Structure = the leaf dataflow of the RTL contract (ot_s81sl_leaf): leafdn bus face -> vp hcpost lane column(s) -> vn_a/vn_b gather hub (hq,
broadcast/gather to all 16 lanes) -> vq -> leafup face; side loop vp SRAMs -x_-> vs engine -> vq u/um; vs hub ring vsw / rxsf->rxsb / ve_m<->ve_s
around vs. The base already follows that order; this change keeps it and only re-seats cores along it: arm pure2 (fc120/fc80 = DS85 rule: lowest
hcpost lane >= 120/80 um above the S face, Tetris sweep off the face with timing-clean spots only), then core_place B34 relocate/swap/flip to
fine-tune bit-mm and the H/V cut shortage. No station changes its register count (EQ); no new pin, no re-pin of signed cores (flips only).
